name: awesome-gpt-image-2
tagline: Prompt as Code — an industrial prompt engine and template library for GPT-Image 2
description: awesome-gpt-image-2 is a large, community-driven library of GPT-Image 2 prompts and techniques built on a "Prompt as Code" philosophy. It ships 500+ reverse-engineered cases, 20+ industrial-grade templates, and distilled skills, with trilingual docs (English, Chinese, Japanese). It is the rare prompt collection that treats prompts like code: versioned, composable, and reusable.
highlights: Skills distilled from the case library
10k+ stars — one of the biggest image-prompt libraries around
curatorNote: Most prompt lists are screenshots of chat logs; this one treats prompts as reusable code with templates and skills. With 10k stars it has already proven the demand — worth mining for your own workflows.
